zh.title: 馬來西亞政府與航空公司商討亞航財務應變
zh.summary: 政府據報與馬航及巴蒂克航空商討接手亞航部分航線；財務惡化
body: 馬來西亞政府據報正與亞洲航空（AirAsia）的兩家競爭對手——馬來西亞航空（Malaysia Airlines）及巴蒂克航空（Batik Air）——進行會談，探討若亞航被迫縮減其馬來西亞航線時，由這兩家業者接手部分航線的可能性。
此舉據報與亞航財務及總體經濟情勢惡化的情境規劃有關，並非針對影響該公司的特定發展。亞航在2026年第二季轉為負面財務結果，淨虧損達8.305億令吉（約2.02億美元），主要受外匯損失、油價上漲及海外子公司虧損影響。
報導指出，馬來西亞政府另委託位於新加坡的阿爾頓航空顧問公司，評估亞航財務狀況及未來可能行動。亞洲際航空公司發言人向AeroTime表示，將於2026年9月18日的記者會提供進一步資訊。

en.title: Malaysia holds contingency talks with airlines as AirAsia's finances worsen
en.summary: Malaysia in talks with Malaysia Airlines, Batik Air on possible route takeover; AirAsia Q2 net loss
body: The Malaysian government is reportedly holding talks with two of AirAsia's competitors, Malaysia Airlines and Batik Air, to explore the possibility of them taking over some of AirAsia's Malaysian routes should the airline be forced to wind them down.

The move is apparently related to scenario planning in connection with the worsening financial and macro-economic situation faced by AirAsia, rather than to any specific development affecting the airline.
In Q2 2026, AirAsia reverted to negative financial results, showing an 830.5 million Ringgit (US$202 million) net loss, despite posting a positive EBITDA of 442.6 million Ringgit (US$109 million).
A spokesperson for AirAsia told AeroTime that the airline will provide additional information during a press conference set to be held on September 18, 2026.
